story.headline: The country that is *wider than the Moon*

post.title: The country that is wider than the Moon 🌕
post.premise: Lay the Moon across this country and it does not reach the other coast
post.bait: Did you know the Moon was that small? 👇
post.description:
Is Australia wider than the Moon? Yes, and this map proves it.
We draw the country's full width from its westernmost rock to its easternmost cape, then lay the Moon's true diameter along the same line and watch where it runs out.
Did you know the Moon was that small? Tell us below.
Satellite imagery: Sentinel-2 cloudless by EOX (CC BY 4.0) · Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2020 · Natural Earth
